name: Lightwell
summary: Two offset planes suggest a sheltered opening and a broad pool of light. Warm clay gives the mark a grounded, welcoming character.
why: A pale wall frames an open space while an ivory plane widens toward the viewer. The composition suggests light entering a quiet room: a calm pause within the day. Its asymmetric geometry creates a compact architectural identity without architectural detail.
risk: The abstract form can also suggest architecture or design; the app name establishes its prayer context.
reasonToChoose: You want the app to feel warm, peaceful, and modern.
